current_assessment: PCU module B has failed. Backup PCU-A is now online and providing power to the bus. Bus voltage has restabilised at 27.6V. However, the backup PCU has not been operationally tested at full load and its thermal profile under sustained operation is not fully characterised. The spacecraft is operating on backup power conditioning with reduced margin and elevated risk.

predicted_failures.failure_mode: Backup PCU-A overload or thermal shutdown under full mission load
early_warning_signs: Current draw transients during attitude maneuvers

predicted_failures.failure_mode: Instrument bay temperature exceeding safe operating limit
Spectrometer thermal shutdown — detector sensitivity degraded

cascading_risks: Single-point failure in power conditioning — no further backup available
Elevated bus impedance on PCU-A may cause voltage sags during thruster firings
PCU failure during a communication window could interrupt critical downlink
Full power failure would trigger emergency safe mode, terminating all science and most housekeeping
recommended_actions: IMMEDIATE: Reduce total power draw to below 350W to reduce PCU-A thermal stress
Suspend all non-essential heaters and science instruments within 30 minutes
Monitor PCU-A temperature every 60 seconds — alert threshold 47°C
Pre-position spacecraft in sun-pointing attitude to maximise solar input and reduce battery dependence
Prepare safe mode entry sequence for autonomous trigger at PCU-A temp >50°C
earth_report:
CRITICAL REPORT — ASTERIA-7 T+09:42

FDIR EVENT: PCU module B electronics failure. Backup PCU-A activated. Bus restabilised.

CURRENT STATUS: CRITICAL — single backup power conditioning unit in operation. No further redundancy available.

PRIMARY RISK: PCU-A thermal failure under sustained load. Estimated 6-18 hour window before risk becomes acute. Instrument bay thermal rise also a near-term concern.

ACTIONS TAKEN BY FDIR: PCU-B isolated, PCU-A switched online, thermal load reduced, computational load shed 30%.

GROUND RECOMMENDATIONS: (1) Authorise emergency power reduction below 350W immediately. (2) Evaluate mission abort criteria. (3) Prepare uplink for safe mode configuration. (4) Prioritise PCU-A status telemetry in all upcoming contact windows.

MISSION IMPACT: Significant. Continued operation at risk. Recommend reducing mission phase to essential functions only.
